issue: Coordinates are angles; trips in many countries (35°S–62°N)
assumption: Distances must be metric and locally accurate
decision: Per-trip local equirectangular projection (validated against haversine, section 6)

issue: No missing / invalid values, timestamps monotonic (train, student_test)
assumption: Evaluator files could still contain bad rows
decision: Cleaning rules kept in load_trip(): drop NaN, out-of-range, non-increasing timestamps

assumption: They are real observations; heading is undefined there
decision: Keep them; windowed heading + speed feature so the model can discount heading

issue: Long time gaps (up to ~42 h in train 90, ~15 h in train 78) with little movement
assumption: Parking pauses inside one trip, not separate drives
decision: Keep trips whole; HMM relaxes transitions with the time gap

issue: Broken reference routes (consecutive route arcs not connected) in 11 trips
assumption: Reference skips short links; GPS is continuous
decision: Keep trips; ordered alignment confines the effect to points near the break; report reference continuity

issue: Route is an ordered arc list, not per-point labels
assumption: Vehicle never moves backwards along its own route
decision: Monotonic DP alignment for per-point labels (section 8)

issue: Trips 33 and 54: most GPS points >100 m from the reference
assumption: Reference does not describe those stretches
decision: Exclude both from training; drop any training point with label distance >100 m

issue: Road networks fragmented into many weak components
assumption: Clipping around each trip; the route lies in the largest component
decision: Keep full network; HMM gives disconnected pairs a finite penalty

issue: ~90% of arcs have a reverse twin at identical distance
assumption: Distance alone cannot choose the direction
decision: Heading, context and network features; HMM transitions penalise U-turns

issue: Fixed top-5 candidates missed the true arc too often and admitted arcs >1 km away
assumption: True arc almost always within 50 m
decision: 50 m radius, k<=8, fallback to 3 nearest (section 9)
